title: Machine Learning Engineering on AWS
summary: This is the code repository for the Packt book 'Machine Learning Engineering on AWS,' covering AWS services for ML engineering and MLOps pipelines, including a chapter on data privacy techniques. Chapter 1's data_generator.py loads a pretrained CTGANSynthesizer from the standalone ctgan package to generate synthetic hotel booking data.
evidence: chapter01/data_generator.py: 'from ctgan import CTGANSynthesizer' and 'gan = CTGANSynthesizer.load(pkl)' used to generate synthetic hotel bookings data
